<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.045 Da. The formula that matches this mass best is C₄H₈O₄ (exact monoisotopic mass 120.0423 Da), and the observed M+1 intensity (~8 %) is consistent with the expected isotopic pattern for a molecule containing four carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
